# Salamandra

> Evidence-first, community-driven 3D-printed FPV aircraft programme. The reasoning is the product:
> every decision carries its rationale, source and provenance tag (`[M]`/`[D]`/`[E]`/`[I]`).
> Derived values are rerunnable; measured inputs retain provenance; unresolved assumptions remain visible.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/guide/01-getting-started/): The shortest path from zero to a working model
- [How to read this repository](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/guide/02-how-to-read/): Folder map and traceability flow
- [Architecture](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/guide/03-architecture/): How research, decisions, gaps, tests and calculations feed each other
- [Drawings and SVG workflow](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/guide/06-drawings/): Generated A3 design-review sheets and their authority boundary
- [Glossary](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/guide/04-glossary/): Confidence tags, identifiers, signs and key terms
- [Contributing](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/guide/05-contributing/): Order of value of contributions and the workflow

## Design

- [Master Design Plan](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/reference/05-master-plan/): Programme sequence, gates and current authorization
- [MP-04 campaign](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/research/i-33-mp04-propulsion-procurement-and-hardware-characterisation/): Current procurement and physical-characterisation work
- [H01–H22 protocol](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/tests/mp04-hardware-characterisation/): Machine-readable physical evidence and closure method
- [Historical Salamandra v0.6](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/salamandra/): The forward-swept comparison candidate retained for audit
- [Historical Design Guide v0.24](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/salamandra/design-guide/): Reproducible v0.6.0 geometry under hold

## Reference

- [Decision record (ADR)](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/decisions/): One file per decision: context, alternatives, consequences
- [Research threads](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/research/): What was searched, found, and with what sources
- [Gap register](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/gaps/): What we do not know and how it gets closed
- [Experimental program](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/tests/): The tests that turn estimates into measurements
- [Calculations](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/calculations/): Validated, rerunnable analysis scripts
- [Reproduction guide](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/calculations/reproduction-guide/): Commands and validation discipline
- [Objectives and requirements](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/reference/00-objectives-and-requirements/): The active Gate-M0 product contract
- [Hardware and power manifest](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/reference/17-article-1-hardware-manifest/): The active pre-measurement M1 interface
- [Historical release v0.6.0](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/reference/16-release-v06/): Latest tagged comparison package and migration record
- [Historical Phase-1 plan](https://bultodepapas.github.io/salamandra/reference/03-phase-1-plan/): Superseded geometry and stability work sequence
